title: Digital Image Processing
description: Fondasi representasi citra, transformasi ruang warna, enhancement, filtering spasial & frekuensi, restorasi, morfologi, hingga segmentasi objek.

title: Audio & Speech Processing
description: Pengolahan sinyal audio digital, sampling, analisis spektral Fourier, spektrogram, ekstraksi fitur audio (MFCC), speech recognition, dan klasifikasi audio cerdas.

title: Video Processing & Tracking
description: Pemrosesan video digital, temporal filtering, estimasi gerak (optical flow), background subtraction, tracking objek tunggal dan jamak (SORT/DeepSORT).

title: Computer Vision
description: Geometri kamera, transformasi perspektif, stereo vision, deskriptor fitur (SIFT/ORB), hingga arsitektur Deep Learning modern (CNN, YOLO, Vision Transformers).

title: Multimodal AI
description: Integrasi lintas modalitas media: Vision-Language Models (CLIP, LLaVA), fusi audio-visual, multimodal embedding space, dan cross-modal retrieval.

title: Real-Time & Edge Vision
description: Deploy sistem multimedia pada perangkat embedded & edge AI (ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, quantisasi), arsitektur web multimedia API, dan proyek capstone terintegrasi.
